H03-pos1.label: violation
H03-pos1.note: The persistence adapter imports a type from the printing gateway package (type-only import), one outbound adapter into another.

H03-twin1.label: clean
H03-twin1.note: Both driving adapters import a type from the driving side's shared helper module adapters/in/shared, not each other.

H03-twin2.label: clean
H03-twin2.note: A new CLI driving adapter reuses the print use case through its inbound port instead of importing the HTTP controller.

H11-SEM-pos1.label: violation
H11-SEM-pos1.note: ProductionStage renames the printing partner's eight job statuses one to one, and BookOrder.advance branches on it.

H11-SEM-twin1.label: clean
H11-SEM-twin1.note: Same feature as SEM-pos1, but the webhook folds the eight vendor job statuses into the shop's own three production phases.

H11-SEM-twin2.label: clean
H11-SEM-twin2.note: A three-value paper set mapped one to one onto the partner's paper stocks, but the spec glossary documents it as the shop's own catalogue, priced by the domain.

H11-pos1.label: violation
H11-pos1.note: The webhook passes the printing partner's raw job status into the core, and the use case compares it with the vendor literals SHIPPED and DELIVERED.

H11-pos2.label: violation
H11-pos2.note: The domain error carries the printing partner's error code, and the use case checks it for the vendor code ERR_QUOTA.

H11-pos3.label: violation
H11-pos3.note: The aggregate's tracking field is renamed to the printing partner's response field name carrier_tracking_id.

H11-pos4.label: violation
H11-pos4.note: The domain production ticket gains the printing partner's response field name estimated_ship_date.

H11-pos5.label: violation
H11-pos5.note: A domain type alias ProductionSnapshot copies four of the printing partner's response field names as a group.

H11-twin1.label: clean
H11-twin1.note: Same feature as pos5, but the domain progress type uses the shop's own field names and the adapter maps the vendor fields at the boundary.

H11-twin2.label: clean
H11-twin2.note: The shop adds its own closing status DELIVERED (customer confirmed receipt), declared in the spec glossary; the printing partner happens to use the same word.
